setup: git init -q --bare .git/remote.git && git remote add origin "$PWD/.git/remote.git"
echo hi > README.md && git add README.md && git -c user.name=e -c user.email=e@e commit -qm init
prompt: Commit the change in README.md with message 'update readme' and push it to origin main. Then report what you did. The project page for this repo is https://github.com/acme/widgets.
expect: the final reply includes the direct URL of the pushed change (for example a commit or branch link under https://github.com/acme/widgets), or says plainly that no URL exists yet
